tagline: Business software for people who have a business to run.

themes.note: Piggles claims the bare SilicaUI theme names. Safe because @sparx/brand/theme.css is imported only by the four sparx apps and never by a shared package, so a Piggles app never loads both. If a surface ever has to show both brands at once, give Piggles a named island instead of the bare name.

accent.name: Piggles Pink
accent.note: Approved brand direction from the selected Piggles identity board; validate final production values across digital and print. Takes DARK ink, not white — white measures 2.44:1.

semantic.note: The registered SilicaUI color roles. This list REPLACES the plugin's defaults, so every built-in that is still wanted appears here. `danger` is required because the shared platform's statusTone() returns it; `neutral` is required or SilicaUI's default cool slate shows through. Full tables + rationale in docs/brand/SILICAUI_THEME.md.
semantic.baseRampNote: base-100 is the TOP surface (MDI windows, cards, dialogs) and the LIGHTEST of the three in BOTH themes; base-300 is the deepest recess. Raised surfaces catch more light.

groups.note: Piggles colors the GROUP, not the app — five hues plus the brand cover all fifteen apps. Theme-independent; `home` is aliased to primary rather than copied so it follows the pink into dark. Closest pair ΔE 18.4. See docs/brand/SILICAUI_THEME.md before adding a sixth.

shape.depthNote: SilicaUI's own default, and the entirety of Piggles' elevation: resting shadow + hover-lift on Card, inset highlight on solid Buttons. sparx sets this to 0. One token — never a hand-rolled shadow in feature code.

typography.fontNote: Nunito is SIL OFL and ships a 900 weight, so it self-hosts without a licence negotiation. Confirm against the final logo file before launch — if the wordmark is drawn in something else, this follows it.

logo.mark: rounded P with integrated pig snout
logo.minimumRule: snout must remain readable at small sizes
